metadata.title: Phase 2C.5B2 WebRTC Input & Clipboard DataChannel Implementation Contract

requirements.observable_behavior: Agent initiates and creates outbound DataChannel labeled 'input-channel' with ordered=true
requirements.notes: Static disassembly proves ordered=1 byte passed to CreateDataChannel (AMD64 0x9e1f4f, ARM64 0x53e588)

requirements.observable_behavior: Agent initiates and creates outbound DataChannel labeled 'clipboard-channel' with ordered=true
requirements.notes: Static disassembly proves ordered=1 byte passed to CreateDataChannel (AMD64 0x9e1ff7, ARM64 0x53e610)

requirements.observable_behavior: Input channel frames incoming messages as JSON_TEXT
requirements.notes: Incoming WebRTC DataChannel message is parsed as UTF-8 JSON text

requirements.observable_behavior: Clipboard channel frames bidirectional messages as JSON_TEXT
requirements.notes: Both inbound set/get requests and outbound clipboard responses use JSON text

requirements.requirement: Inject Touch Event JSON Parsing & Translation
requirements.observable_behavior: Messages with discriminator 'inject_touch' (or 'touch') are parsed with action, pointer id, x, y, width, height, and pressure
requirements.notes: Action maps 0=DOWN, 1=UP, 2=MOVE. X/Y/W/H are integer pixel coordinates

requirements.observable_behavior: Parsed touch event serializes to a 32-byte big-endian binary frame (type=2, action, pointerId, x, y, w, h, pressure, actionButton, buttons)
requirements.notes: Disassembly proof at AMD64 0x9cfb54-0x9cfc0e: bswap and rol instructions into 32-byte buffer (ecx=0x20)

requirements.requirement: Inject Keycode Event JSON Parsing & Serialization
requirements.observable_behavior: Messages with discriminator 'inject_keycode' serialize to a 14-byte big-endian binary frame (type=0, action, keycode, repeat, metaState)
requirements.notes: Disassembly at AMD64 0x9e3ace (handler rKbdAxdt); ControlMessageReader parseInjectKeycode

requirements.requirement: Inject Text Event JSON Parsing & Serialization
requirements.observable_behavior: Messages with discriminator 'inject_text' serialize to a binary frame of 1 byte type=1, 4 bytes uint32 big-endian length, followed by UTF-8 bytes
requirements.notes: Disassembly at AMD64 0x9e3a4d (handler cMG2_76Q); ControlMessageReader parseInjectText

requirements.requirement: Inject Scroll Event JSON Parsing & Serialization
requirements.observable_behavior: Messages with discriminator 'inject_scroll' serialize to a 21-byte big-endian binary frame (type=3, x, y, w, h, hScroll, vScroll, buttons)
requirements.notes: Disassembly at AMD64 0x9e3c07 (handler yUpFvK); ControlMessageReader parseInjectScrollEvent

requirements.requirement: Hard Keyboard Settings Event JSON Parsing & Serialization
requirements.observable_behavior: Messages with discriminator 'hard_keyboard' serialize to a 1-byte binary frame (type=15)
Agent writes serialized scrcpy control frames to a narrow ControlSink interface abstracting the @uds_sys_t_ IPC socket
requirements.notes: Concrete socket connection to @uds_sys_t_ mapped as GENERATED_ADAPTER / IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE

requirements.observable_behavior: Messages on clipboard-channel with type 'set_clipboard' extract text, paste flag, and origin_client_id, passing to ClipboardProvider
requirements.notes: Disassembly at AMD64 0x9e3860; string origin_client_id confirmed in binary rodata

requirements.requirement: Get Clipboard Ingress Handling and Response
requirements.observable_behavior: Messages on clipboard-channel with type 'get_clipboard' retrieve text from ClipboardProvider and transmit JSON response {type: 'clipboard', text, source: 'device', origin_client_id: null}
requirements.notes: Disassembly at AMD64 0x9e38ce; response schema corroborated by useWebRTC.js onmessage

requirements.observable_behavior: Clipboard operations interact via a narrow ClipboardProvider interface (Get/Set) without requiring live Android ClipboardManager in tests
requirements.notes: In-memory test mock classified as IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE

requirements.observable_behavior: Malformed JSON, invalid types, empty strings, truncated payloads, and unknown event discriminators are dropped gracefully without panic
requirements.notes: Defensive parsing invariant prevents crashing Agent goroutines on untrusted client input

requirements.requirement: Strict Deferred Boundary for Other Channels
requirements.observable_behavior: Channels 'camera-channel', 'file-channel', 'ai-command-channel', and 'adb-channel' remain deferred with inert lifecycle hooks only
requirements.notes: Accidental implementation of business logic on deferred channels is strictly prohibited in B2
